# Logic

Plain functions with no React in them: formatting, validation, address formats, totals. They are covered by the tests in `lib.test.ts`.

## `address.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `COUNTRIES` | Address formats for the countries the demo ships to. Pass your own list to cover more. |
| `postalWord` | The postal label as it reads mid-sentence: "ZIP code" stays, "Postcode" becomes "postcode". |
| `isAddressComplete` | Enough of the address is filled in to ask for shipping rates. |
| `addressKey` | The parts of an address that change its shipping rates, as one comparable string. |
| `addressLines` | An address as display lines: name, street, apartment, "City ST 12345", country. Empty lines are dropped. |

## `card.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `detectCardBrand` | Brand from the first digits; '' when not recognised yet. |
| `formatCardNumber` | Groups of four, or 4-6-5 for American Express. Extra digits are dropped. |
| `formatExpiry` | Turns typed digits into "MM / YY". A first digit above 1 gets a leading zero. `deleting` and `previous` let a backspace over the separator remove a digit instead of bouncing back. |
| `isExpiryValid` | True for a complete "MM / YY" that is this month or later. |
| `isCardNumberPlausible` | Long enough to be a card number. Real validation belongs to the payment provider. |

## `email.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `DOMAIN_TYPOS` | Common slips in email domains and what was meant. |
| `looksLikePhone` | True once the text reads as the start of a phone number, which is when the flag chip appears. |
| `startsLikePhone` | True when the text starts like a phone number, used to pick the right error message. |
| `suggestEmailFix` | The corrected address when the domain is a known typo, otherwise null. |

## `ids.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `CONTACT_FIELD_ID` | DOM ids of the checkout's fields. A billing address uses the same ids with a `b-` prefix. |

## `money.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `formatMoney` | Formats a decimal amount with the browser's own currency rules. |

## `motion.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `DURATION` | Durations and curves measured on the reference checkout, for use from JavaScript. The CSS tokens hold the same values. |
| `wait` | Resolves after `ms`, or at once when the visitor asked for reduced motion. |
| `reflow` | Forces layout so a following style change animates from the current state. |

## `totals.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `computeTotals` | subtotal − discount + shipping, rounded to cents. A production site should take totals from its server (tax, rounding rules) and only display them. |

## `validate.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `contactError` | The contact field's error, or null when it is fine. `final` is true on submit, when an empty field is an error; on blur an empty field is left alone. |
| `postalBlurError` | The postal field's error on blur: only a filled-in, malformed code is flagged. |
| `addressErrors` | Errors for a whole address on submit, in field order. |
| `cardNumberBlurError` | The card number's error on blur: only a started, too-short number is flagged. |
| `expiryBlurError` | The expiry's error on blur: only a filled-in, invalid date is flagged. |
| `cardErrors` | Errors for the card fields on submit, in field order. |
